notes: Three local Green profiles inside Cornerman Tier-3 (not global CVL tiers). Green Deep for long complex repo work, Green Daily for recurring, Green Fast for triage. See CORNERMAN_MODEL_ROUTING.md.

catalog.role: Green Deep — long repo analysis, architecture distillation, complex multi-file outbox batches (use for GO SHELL prep, big ecosystem mapping)
Green Daily (default) — faster recurring prep, comparisons, audits, structured Markdown, inbox/outbox
Green Fast — triage, routing, indexing, short summaries
on-demand C#/Razor drafts — WarmCoder only; Red reviews before ship. Keep as experimental specialist.
RAG embeddings — paired with daily or deep when needed

steps: Download in LM Studio on Green (Developer Mode + lms CLI)
Add entry to this file catalog[] with id, role, dailyServe, vramGbEstimate
Update Start-CornermanLmStudio.ps1 warmProfiles if daily/on-demand lane changes
Run Fix-CornermanLmServe.ps1 from VENGEANCE; verify Get-CvlConnectivityStatus cornerman.tier3Serve
